description.value:
As an action, you can make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by a creature's Wisdom (Insight), provided it can hear you and shares a language with you. If you win against a hostile creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you and can't make opportunity attacks against anyone but you, for 1 minute or until a companion of yours attacks or affects it with a power, or until you and it are more than 60 feet apart.

If you win against a creature that isn't hostile, it becomes charmed by you for 1 minute, treating you as a friendly acquaintance, an effect that ends immediately if you or your allies do anything to harm it.
